title: Two-pass capture: project-aware precision pass + project-blind recall pass
summary: Precision (what's reusable in THIS kind of work) and recall (catch the off-topic tangent) pull in opposite directions inside a single filter — run them as two separate passes instead of one compromise pass.
detail: Pass 1 is tuned to a one-line project-nature descriptor and applies a hard gate (reusable beyond this task AND non-obvious). Pass 2 ignores the project entirely and just flags sparks as an unclassified 'seed' — placement happens later, by recurrence or decay, not at capture time.

title: Never let a similarity threshold auto-decide keep/drop
summary: Statistics propose (score, shortlist neighbors); only the AI adjudicates the semantic call (same idea? worth keeping?). A bare embedding-distance cutoff will silently merge distinct ideas or silently drop real ones.
trigger: before wiring any embedding/similarity score into an automated keep-vs-drop or merge-vs-spawn decision

title: Two contracts, nothing else crosses layers
summary: Keeping exactly two data contracts (prompt-to-body is a JSON entry; body-to-AI/viz is graph.json + MCP tools) is what makes the system portable across any assistant that can read an instruction file and shell out — everything else stays internal to one part and is free to change.
